training_data: Psychology Clinic, Affiliated Hospital of Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang (2020-2021): 200 depressed patients followed 1 year (145 developed MCI/55 did not); forward stepwise logistic regression on BDNF + FGF22 + P300 latency, classification cut-off 0.5; derivation AUC 0.790
test_data: Independent validation cohort from People's Hospital of Yangzhong City, recruited with the same criteria and 1-year follow-up: 72 patients (44 MCI/28 no MCI); combined model sensitivity 0.795, specificity 0.821, accuracy 0.806
reason: The logistic model (published equation, 0.5 cut-off) was derived at the Affiliated Hospital of Jiangsu University and then evaluated on a separately recruited cohort from another hospital (People's Hospital of Yangzhong City), which is V4, not V1. The paper does not say explicitly that the derivation coefficients were applied unchanged, but it reports only sensitivity, specificity and accuracy against observed outcomes and describes no refitting; one co-author is affiliated with the Yangzhong hospital.

quotes.quote: Patients with depression but without cognitive impairment who attended the Psychology Clinic of the Affiliated Hospital of Jiangsu University from January 2020 to December 2021 were included in the study.

The same recruitment criteria were used to recruit an independent validation cohort from the People’s Hospital of Yangzhong City, which included a total of 72 patients with depression. Demographic, serological and ERP data were collected. The same cognitive follow-up was performed for 1 year to observe the occurrence of MCI.

Data from the DWM group and the DWOM group were used to construct a logistic regression model, and a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve was drawn. Another 72 patients were used to validate the accuracy of our model.
The classification criterion value is set at 0.5, and the maximum number of iterations is limited to 20.

In the independent validation cohort, the incidence of MCI in patients with depression during 1 year of follow-up was 61.11% (44 patients developed MCI and 28 patients did not develop MCI). We conducted analyses to validate the predictive efficacy of the P300 latency, FGF22 + P300 latency, and BDNF + FGF22 + P300 latency.
The sensitivity, specificity and accuracy of BDNF + FGF22 + P300 latency were 0.795, 0.821 and 0.806, respectively.
